ننبلع (form VII)
# نَنْبَلِعُ (nanbaliʕu) /nan.ba.li.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْبَلَعَ (inbalaʕa)
# نَنْبَلِعَ (nanbaliʕa) /nan.ba.li.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْبَلَعَ (inbalaʕa)
# نَنْبَلِعْ (nanbaliʕ) /nan.ba.liʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْبَلَعَ (inbalaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
